# AI Tool Digest — Machine-Readable Site Overview

## What this is
AI Tool Digest is an independent technical journalism platform delivering empirical benchmarks, architectural guides, and breaking model updates for engineering teams across Tier-1 countries (US, UK, CA, AU).
